integrity: The singular quadratic normal form, all finite fibers, residue image formula and limiting density follow from the supplied self-contained proof. An independent mathematical audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The proof concerns only the fixed consecutive fourth-power polynomial at the prime three. Other primes and exponents are outside scope. The density is local residue/Haar density, not ordinary integer-value density. Completeness is proved through Hensel lifting and analytic isometry; finite checks corroborate. Full bibliographic priority has not been independently certified.
title: Exact ternary image and fibers of two consecutive fourth powers
